subject: URGENT: BrightWave throughput stall in us-west2 — request for geo-evacuation
messages:
From: Samir Shah <samir@brightwave.ai>
To: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@brightwave.ai
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Degraded throughput + 5xx spike in us-west2 (urgent)

Hi Priya —

We started seeing a sharp drop in throughput (20–40% request drops) and a growing 5xx rate from your us-west2 region around 13:45 PDT. Latency climbed from ~180ms to >1.2s for our production model workload. Attach two short artifacts: a minute-sampled request log and a screenshot of our dashboard.

Impact: our paid customers are seeing failed requests and UI lockups; one customer (FinLedger) has already opened an incident and is demanding telemetry and a mitigation timeline.

Can you please:
- Confirm this is a regional Redwood issue (not our traffic/client-side)
- If so, request an immediate traffic evacuation to another region (us-east1) until you stabilize us-west2
- We also need a temporary increase in concurrency / burst capacity while traffic is moved — we will accept cross-region routing if it avoids request loss

This is high urgency. If we need an exec-level contact, please escalate.

Thanks,
Samir
Head of Platform
BrightWave AI

Attachments: request-samples.txt (text), latency-graphs-usw2.png (image)
From: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir@brightwave.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 14:18:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Degraded throughput + 5xx spike in us-west2 (urgent)

Samir — thanks for the quick flag and the artifacts. I’m escalating immediately and looping in our on-call infra (Evelyn) and CS escalation lead (Rishi). Markus — tagging for visibility and potential customer outreach.

Short plan:
1) We’ll validate impact and confirm whether this is infra (Redwood) or upstream (BrightWave) within 15 minutes.
2) If it’s regional Redwood degradation, we will initiate a geo-evacuation to us-east1 and enable model-variant fallback to a compatible quantized variant to reduce memory pressure.
3) We’ll propose an interim credit offer and follow-up postmortem.

I’ll update within 20 minutes with next steps.

— Priya
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Samir Shah <samir@brightwave.ai>
Cc: evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 14:23:45 -07:00
Subject: Re: Degraded throughput + 5xx spike in us-west2 (urgent)

Samir / Priya — I’m on it. Can you send: 1) a few request IDs (trace ids) showing the 502/503/504s, and 2) the traffic distribution (percent of requests pinned to us-west2)? That will help us confirm routing vs model-level degradation.

Immediate mitigation options (short list):
- Traffic steer to us-east1 via our smart-routing policy (we can do weighted shift in ~3 min)
- Hot-warm model fallback: route to a lower-memory quantized variant that supports same API and reduces evictions
- Temporary concurrency bump on Dedicated hosts for BrightWave (if they are on Dedicated)

If BrightWave is hosted on our Shared cluster in us-west2, traffic steer is fastest. Evelyn, can infra validate capacity in us-east1 for a +30% bump?

— Rishi
Director, Customer Escalations
Redwood Inference
From: evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Samir Shah <samir@brightwave.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 14:27:58 -07:00
Subject: Re: Degraded throughput + 5xx spike in us-west2 (urgent)

Quick infra readout:
- We’re seeing memory pressure and intermittent node OOMs on a subset of us-west2 N-GPU hosts hosting the quantized variant for several customers. Kernel-level GC is thrashing for long sequences; CPU steal is elevated.
- Error surface: 502/503 correlated with host eviction events and a backlog in the request queue (queue length metric >200).

Immediate actions I recommend (order matters):
A) Execute traffic evacuation: shift 80% of BrightWave traffic to us-east1 over 5 minutes with 10% incremental steps (monitor tail latency). This avoids mass cache misses.
B) Simultaneously enable fallback to the next-compatible quantized variant that has a smaller KV footprint (variant-q8f). Variant change is transparent to clients.
C) Temporarily increase per-tenant concurrency quota for BrightWave by +30% on us-east1; we can do this for 2 hours while steady-state is validated.
D) We’ll hold us-west2 in read-only for the workload until we stabilize and reprovision failing hosts.

Evelyn — infra on-call
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: internal capacity snapshot (not shared in thread)
From: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir@brightwave.ai>, ops@brightwave.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 14:33:10 -07:00
Subject: Re: Degraded throughput + 5xx spike in us-west2 (urgent)

Samir — we will start the traffic evacuation in ~4 minutes. Summary of what to expect:
- 14:37 PDT: Begin weighted shift (10% -> 20% -> 40% -> 60% -> 80% over ~5 minutes) to us-east1.
- Variant switch: variant-q8f will be activated for requests routed to us-east1 to reduce memory pressure.
- Concurrency bump: temporary +30% on us-east1 for 2 hours.

Please confirm you are ready to accept traffic in us-east1 and that there are no org-level IP allowlists blocking the new egress. If legal needs to sign anything for credits we will route to Markus.

— Priya
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir@brightwave.ai>, priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 15:01:23 -07:00
Subject: Re: Degraded throughput + 5xx spike in us-west2 (urgent)

Samir — I’m very sorry for the disruption. Priya, Rishi, Evelyn: thank you for the rapid mobilization.

On behalf of Redwood, we will:
- Execute the geo-evacuation and capacity increase as planned (Rishi/Evelyn managing the details).
- Offer BrightWave a one-time credit equal to 10% of October bill or an agreed-upon service credit schedule; we’ll expedite a short term credit term sheet for signature (DocuSign).
- Commit to a customer-facing postmortem within 72 hours and a remediation timeline for host reprovisioning and improved congestion controls.

Samir — if you want an exec call to walk customers through the mitigation, I’m available this afternoon (16:00–17:30 PDT).

— Markus Klein
VP, Customer Success & Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed-credits-term-sheet.pdf
From: Samir Shah <samir@brightwave.ai>
To: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@brightwave.ai, contracts@brightwave.ai
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 18:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Degraded throughput + 5xx spike in us-west2 (urgent)

Thanks all — we saw successful failover behavior starting ~14:40 PDT and the 5xx rate dropped back to baseline by ~14:49. Latency is back to acceptable ranges for now. We accept the proposed credit offer; contracts will review the DocuSign.

A few asks before we close the loop:
- Please share the short postmortem and the list of mitigations that will prevent recurrence (cache pre-warm, eviction thresholds, placement constraints).
- Confirm the exact time window and scope for the +30% concurrency bump for billing reconciliation.
- We would like a short exec call tomorrow to align with FinLedger (their CS expects an update).

Appreciate the fast response.

— Samir
Head of Platform, BrightWave AI
